name: POST /api/leadflow/capture/extension - Transmit a confirmed browser capture
description:
Receives a browser capture AFTER the operator has confirmed it in the preview. A create at a collection root, so it answers 201.

THE SERVER IS THE SECOND GUARD, NOT THE ONLY ONE. The extension is where the privacy rules are enforced first — it reads only the user's selection and never touches hidden DOM, cookies or credentials. But an endpoint that trusts its client is not a guardrail, so this refuses a payload that could not have come from a legitimate selection: `confirmed` must be true, and any field carrying a credential-shaped key is rejected outright rather than stripped. Stripping would accept the request and quietly discard evidence that the client is misbehaving; rejecting says so.

NOTHING ARRIVES WITHOUT CONFIRMATION. `confirmed:false` is a 422, not a 400 — the payload is well-formed and the refusal is about consent rather than syntax. A capture the operator has not seen and approved is exactly the background harvesting this feature exists to make impossible.

THE SOURCE URL IS OPTIONAL AND OFF BY DEFAULT. It is transmitted only when `retainSourceUrl` is true, matching the checkbox. The transmission preview tells the operator which of the three classes each field falls into — visible selection always included, source URL only if checked, cookies and hidden DOM never — and this endpoint honours that table rather than re-deciding it.

ORIGIN IS ALWAYS USER_PROVIDED. A person selected this text and pressed a button; that is the strongest provenance claim available and it is not the caller's to override.

Every accepted transmission appends capture.created naming the acting persona and the domain. Protected by the authenticate guard. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A confirmed capture is accepted and recorded

payload.selectedText: Priya Raman, Raman Roofing Ltd, priya@ramanroofing.example

testCases.name: The source URL is retained ONLY when the operator checked the box
REFUSE an unconfirmed capture - this is the background-harvesting guard
REFUSE a payload carrying a credential-shaped field
REFUSE a password field, whatever else the payload looks like
Reject a capture with no selected text - there is nothing to record

errorCases.message: selectedText and domain are required; quickAction must be one of contact, property, lead
errorCases.when: the selection or the domain is missing, or quickAction is outside its vocabulary
the Authorization header is absent or the token does not verify

errorCases.message: A browser capture must be confirmed in the preview before it is transmitted
errorCases.when: confirmed is absent or false. 422 rather than 400 because the payload is well-formed and the refusal is about consent, not syntax.

errorCases.message: This payload carries a field that must never leave the page
errorCases.when: the body contains a cookie, token, password or hidden-input field. Rejected rather than stripped: stripping would accept the request and silently discard the evidence that a client is sending what it must never read.

errorCases.message: Capture is restricted on this domain by tenant policy
errorCases.when: the tenant's policy blocks automated capture for the domain. Manual entry remains available — see the domain-policy endpoint.
